doc.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

chapter: Riverside and the New York scene
title: Recording "The Chicago Sound" for Riverside
summary: Keepnews gives the Chicago players a date with Griffin, Junior Mance, Wilbur Campbell and John Jenkins; Ware says they simply ran it down.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And Monk called me up just to play on one track of his Thelonious's album, his solo album. And about this time, Johnnie Griffin was in New York; Jimmy Mann was there working, and Wilbur Camel came out from Chicago, so Keepnews people said, 'well, it's time for your own ...' he didn't call me until Lionel phoned me; he got word to me, and he say, 'You got a date tomorrow', and I said, 'My date? I got no material.' And he said, 'Well, you be in the studio at such and such a time.'
Thelonious Himself Johnny Junior Mance Campbell
Wilbur, 'cause I didn't have a phone
So all of us Chicago guys were going to record. And

sure enough, there was Johnny Griffin, Lou Cannon, Johnnie James on alto; Wilbur Campbell, Junior Mance, John Jenkins we got in the studio, and I just said what we gonna play -- and we run it down, and we did it. Well, that's something -- most of the things were like that, and I think Johnson had one tune that he, that he said he arranged, you know.

But that's not to be taken lightly, because I was thinking about what Duke said about having to learn music two different ways, and he was taught how to learn music, but then he heard James Pete Johnson, and that was a different experience; a different learning experience, and he ended up memorizing things in a way that is very unusual, very peculiar. So I think that's important that you just went in and recorded that, and the end result is Chicago sound, because that's a very beautiful notable album.
Well, yes. I'm of the school where we could play; we look at each other and we'd have an arrangement; I mean, you just have this feeling for one another.
